description: This file defines the class ElasticSearchModuleDataPuller, which facilitates pulling SugarCRM/SuiteCRM module records from the database, with support for differential and full data pulls. It includes methods for batching, querying, and filtering records based on modification time or deletion status.

classes.name: ElasticSearchModuleDataPuller
classes.description: A class that pulls data from a specified CRM module, supporting differential and full synchronization modes, with batching and filtering capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the data puller with the target module, differential mode flag, and a logger instance.

methods.name: setLastIndexTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for the last index operation to enable differential pulls.

methods.name: setShowDeleted
methods.description: Specifies whether to include deleted records in the pull results.

methods.name: setDifferential
methods.description: Configures whether the pull should be differential, affecting the filtering query.

methods.name: pullNextBatch
methods.description: Retrieves the next batch of records from the module, updating offset and count.

methods.name: generateWhere
methods.description: Builds the SQL WHERE clause for the list query based on differential flag and last index time.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to access protected class properties.
